description: Four independent quantizers that snap a voltage to a grid of equal slices, with 0V as the base of the grid. The number of slices is set as a figure on each row

inputs.text: The voltage that row snaps to its grid

outputs.text: That row's voltage snapped to a slice of the grid

menu: Voltage to slice (Voltage / slices), with 0v base — sets the span that is cut into slices
ROUNDING MODE — places a voltage falling between two slices: floor mode takes the slice below, ceil mode the slice above, round mode the nearer of the two
